description: The bar chart illustrates a performance comparison between two language models—Flan-T5-783M (blue bars) and GPT-4 (red bars)—across six evaluation metrics derived from three datasets: TriviaQA, HotPotQA, and 2Wiki, each assessed under two scoring criteria: Exact Match (EM) and F1 score. The vertical axis represents performance scores ranging from 25 to 85, with major gridlines at intervals of 10. For TriviaQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M scores 77.3 while GPT-4 scores 77.1; for HotPotQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M achieves 37.0 versus GPT-4’s 31.9; and for 2Wiki (EM), Flan-T5-783M scores 44.5 compared to GPT-4’s 32.5. In F1 scores, TriviaQA shows Flan-T5-783M at 82.8 and GPT-4 at 83.8; HotPotQA F1 scores are 49.7 for Flan-T5-783M and 43.3 for GPT-4; and 2Wiki F1 scores are 53.3 for Flan-T5-783M and 38.1 for GPT-4. The chart visually emphasizes that GPT-4 outperforms Flan-T5-783M on TriviaQA F1, while Flan-T5-783M leads on all other metrics, particularly dominating on 2Wiki EM and F1. The bars are grouped by dataset and metric, with blue and red bars placed side-by-side for direct comparison, and numerical values are labeled atop each bar for precise reading. The chart supports the paper’s exploration of when to continue searching in multi-round RAG systems by highlighting model-specific strengths and weaknesses across diverse question-answering benchmarks.
